items.heading: Grapevine Daily Quote November 9
items.text: It’s not the wonderful people I’ve met from throughout these great lands who have helped keep me sober most of the time, but those wonderful people sitting around the table in my hometown who loved me when I could not love, who waited for me to quit lying, who tolerated me when I would be part of nothing, and who never asked me to leave when I was obnoxious. Because of their love and patience, I was able to get outside of myself and make some sort of commitment to the group.
items.attribution: “Why Have a Home Group?” Neosho, Missouri, September 1986, The Home Group: Heartbeat of AA

items.heading: Cita Diaria con La Viña Noviembre 9
items.text: La mejor forma de apreciar a AA es idéntica a como se aprecia un vitral: desde adentro.
items.attribution: “Reuniones, reuniones, reuniones”. GRAND RAPIDS, MICHIGAN, OCTUBRE DE 1981
